description: This file defines the IndexToLocationTable class, which manages the 'loca' table in an OpenType font, storing glyph offsets and handling binary serialization/deserialization.

classes.name: IndexToLocationTable
classes.description: Represents the 'loca' table in an OpenType font, providing methods to read, prepare, and write glyph location data.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the 'loca' table data from font, determining format and populating LocaTable array.

methods.name: PrepareForCompilation
methods.description: Prepares the font table's binary data for serialization, updating directory entry and checksum.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes the binary data of the 'loca' table to the provided font writer.
